title: Rory and the Starlight Cavern
verses:
When evening descended on moss-covered trees,
Then Rory walked slow through the shadowy lane.
Nia swooped down on a whispering breeze,
To guide all her friends from the incoming rain.

Psittaco rested on blankets of leaves,
While Ricky crept over to curl on the floor.
The night-wind blew softly beneath the high eaves,
As Benny let out a grand slumberous snore.

They marched to a canyon where starlight shone clear,
And Tilly stepped first in the glowing blue stream.
The waters ran softly and cool for the year,
To carry each friend to a sleepy young dream.

High up in a cavern of silver and stone,
Where fireflies danced in a circle of light,
Rory sat down with a warmth of his own,
And watched as the valleys turned quiet and white.

Benny lay heavy and still on the moss,
While Nia tucked under a canopy wide.
They counted the sleepy stars drifting across,
With Ricky and Tilly tucked safe at their side.

The shadows grew long as the night settled down,
And Psittaco yawned in a sleepy embrace.
Now Rory closed eyes over forest and town,
As peace settled over this magical place.

title: The Secret of the Whispering Falls
verses:
The sun dipped away behind ridges of blue,
When Nia swooped low with a chirp of delight.
She led all her friends through the shimmering dew,
To find where the waterfall glowed in the night.

Behind the cool spray was a wide, hidden shelf,
Where giant soft ferns caught the mist in the air.
Each dinosaur found a dry spot for itself,
Content with the magical calm waiting there.

Psittaco gathered dry leaves in a heap,
And made a small cushion right next to the wall.
His chirps turned to whispers, preparing for sleep,
Entranced by the soothing cascade of the fall.

Then Ricky and Benny worked side by side now,
To roll a large boulder to block out the chill.
With teamwork complete and a yawn from the brow,
They felt all the bustle of daytime go still.

Sweet Tilly leaned close to the thunder-soft sound,
Her heavy tail resting along the damp stone.
A blanket of tranquility settled around,
Ensuring that nobody rested alone.

Green Rory sank down with a satisfied sigh,
His mighty green tail curled up close to his chest.
With moon-shadows drifting across the dark sky,
The friends closed their eyes and surrendered to rest.
